brand_notes.signature_hardware: Restrap's whole visual identity is hardware on webbing. Four fittings recur across the range and a model without them does not read as a Restrap: (1) the FIDLOCK magnetic buckle - a two-part moulded block roughly 45 x 20 x 12mm, matte black body with a brushed metal-look face plate, sitting on a 25mm webbing tail; it closes by self-aligning magnets and releases by sliding sideways. It is the single closure on every holster product (Saddle Bag 8/14/18L, Race Saddle Bag, Race Aero Bar Bag, Rolltop Canister, Holster Bar Bag Plus, City Loader). (2) The FLAT MOULDED HOOK - a low-profile black plate about 35 x 18mm with an upturned tongue, bar-tacked onto the end of a 25mm webbing strap, caught by a thin black elastic loop that stretches round the tube; used on every top-tube bag head-tube strap and on the bar bags' head-tube retention. (3) The CAM LOCK - a flat black moulded cam lever, about 40 x 22mm, on 25mm webbing; used on all frame bags, both Switch bags and (spring-loaded) as the handlebar clamp on the Bar Pack and Holster Bar Bags. (4) Reflective PARACORD laced through reinforced metal eyelets around the circular end cap of the Adventure Saddle Bag holster - about fourteen eyelets round a 16-18cm disc, laced like a shoe. All webbing is heavy and visibly bar-tacked at every terminus.
brand_notes.labels: Two vegan PU 'leather-look' labels in tan/amber (#c8862a-ish) with a black outline: a landscape RECTANGLE reading RESTRAP (about 55 x 18mm) and a DIAMOND about 40mm across carrying a crossed-needles / sundial mark. One or the other appears on nearly every bag. The lightweight Race line drops the leather label for a white screen-printed RESTRAP wordmark with a needle-and-line device, and the dry bags carry a white circular RESTRAP ambigram logo (readable either way up) on the end cap.
brand_notes.fabrics: Adventure and City lines: 'textured nylon', a matte woven canvas-look coated fabric with visible weave, plus glossy TPU-coated laminated panels on lower halves, zip tapes and Switch bags. Race line: X-Pac (visible X-grid) and TPX technical outer, plus recycled ripstop on the Aero TT bag. All dry bags are a smooth lightweight coated nylon that reads noticeably lighter and shinier than the holster around it. Hypalon is used for reinforcement spines, moulded strap keepers and the Bar Pack front-compartment flap. Orange accents throughout: orange cord zip pulls, orange RESTRAP webbing tabs, orange lining in the Fork Bag and Bar Pack.
brand_notes.holster_architecture: The saddle packs and bar packs above 7L are TWO products, not one: a hard-shell HOLSTER that clamps to the bike and a separate DRY BAG that drops into it. The dry bag is retained by a hook-and-loop 'GripTight' patch plus a Fidlock strap. Bar-mounted dry bags are DOUBLE-ENDED - they roll shut at both ends and both rolled ends protrude beyond the holster shell. Saddle-mounted dry bags roll at the tail only; the nose is a closed cap that sits against the holster's disc bulkhead.

mount.notes: FITMENT: this is a FRONT bag on a Brompton, not a pannier. It mounts on the Brompton front carrier block on the head tube, so it does not turn with the bar and it cannot fit a 56cm drop-bar gravel bike at all without that block. Restrap state it clears the Brompton front light, dyno light and reflector and does not affect the fold, but it is not compatible with the Brompton Electric. slot is recorded as pannier in the catalogue and should be a front/bar slot.
